title: zuslothdb 0.0.0.9000
text: table 2048 rows NULL past row 2048 longer reads back NULLs none, crashes R: engine kept whole row group’s NULLs mask size one vector, INSERT 2048 VALUES wrote past buffers (#45). DATE columns arrive Date, TIMESTAMP POSIXct BLOB list raw vectors blob::blob()’s classes. dbConnect(timezone_out = ) sets time zone POSIXct shown , "UTC" default duckdb; unknown zone error. HUGEINT TIME column zuslothdb_type_error, since SlothDB computes values wrongly (TIME always midnight), INTERVAL UUID. SlothDB produces DECIMAL, time zone, list, struct, map union column. set operation (UNION, UNION , INTERSECT, EXCEPT) returns TINYINT, SMALLINT FLOAT columns values; returned numbers made unwritten memory (#41). Windows, Parquet query one thread decodes several row groups longer ends R session (#34). Parquet query stops file’s last row group, LIMIT, longer hangs now : engine’s decode workers miss signal stop (#32). dbSendQuery(), dbFetch(), dbGetQuery() result methods return data frames. Boolean, integer, floating-point VARCHAR columns arrive logical, integer, double UTF-8 character; dbConnect(bigint = ) chooses double, integer64 character 64-bit integers. value R hold exactly zuslothdb_type_error, never silent change. dbExecute() longer reads query’s one-row BIGINT column named Count row count. zuslothdb() DBI driver, used duckdb::duckdb() : holds one database, memory file, connections share. dbConnect(), dbDisconnect(), dbIsValid(), dbGetInfo() show() work driver connection, dbExecute() runs statements returns rows changed. dbConnect(read_only = TRUE) refuses every statement change database never writes file. dbConnect(threads = ) caps engine’s threads, 2 default; engine one thread pool per process, cap process-wide. file database written last connection closes. connection used forked child zuslothdb_closed_error.
